en: Kirumi, I need to say something to you.
Is it a request?

There is no need for formal pleasantries.
Simply state your request.

That! That right there, Kirumi! It's both
your best and your worst quality!
I beg your pardon...?
You spoil people too much!

And because of that, everyone is becoming
too dependent on you!

I do not mind. Serving others is what every
maid truly desires.

Hmm, that's not what I mean! I understand
you're passionate about serving others...

But at this rate, everyone's gonna start calling
you "mom." Is that what you want?

Do not call me that. I am a high school
student like the rest of you.
See? You don't like to be called that, do you?

Kaede, I think you misunderstand the role
of a servant.

A servant performs their duties while also
respecting their master as a person.
A servant does not "spoil" anyone.

<CLT=cltMIND>Hmmm... You may say that, but I still think
you're spoiling them.
Um, Kirumi, I've been thinking...

...maybe the intent behind your desire to
serve isn't getting through to us.
What...do you mean by that?
For example, in a piano recital...

No matter how earnestly I play, only the
people who care to listen will hear me.

I understand. It is unfortunate, but to those
in the audience who are not interested...

A performance from the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Pianist<CLT=cltNORMAL> may
sound like a cacophonous din to them.

Yeah, I always hope that those people will
gain a greater appreciation for music...
...Wait, that's not my point!

My point is, you may believe you are serving
others with the best of intentions...

But that doesn't mean those you serve will
appreciate your help.

It'll just come across as you spoiling them,
because you're not considering your needs.
Do you really think that?

Yeah! And that's not the kind of maid you
want to be, is it?
...No. You are correct.

In pursuing my principle of <CLT=cltSTRONG>selfless devotion<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
I must consider my own satisfaction as well.

Because of you, I was able to re-examine
my principles. ...Thank you.
Don't mention it.

<CLT=cltMIND>I thought I was being too nosy, but...I'm glad
I ended up helping Kirumi.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kirumi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>After parting ways with Kirumi, I returned
to my room.
